data.name: Mom Said Get Off the Couch
data.headline: Home for the summer and Mom's already said 'do something'?
data.benefit: Home for the summer and Mom's already said 'do something'? 8 classes at 20% off for students — in the hours when the studio is basically yours.
data.rationale: Weekday 10–12 and weekend 4–7 pm run 27–41% full; the marginal cost of a seat there is near zero. Students arriving home in May are a predictable, untapped audience.
data.conditions: Discount only exists in empty slots; ≤20%. Claim by 2027-06-30.
data.kpi: Golden Hours fill (target +15 pts); student repeat purchase.

data.name: Mom-entum
data.headline: She carried you for 9 months. You can carry her to class.
data.benefit: She carried you for 9 months. You can carry her to class. Mother–child duos get a 30-minute duo private and a gift for mum. New to P57? Your first month is 15% off.
data.rationale: Duos with a booked second class convert best; Mother's Day gives a reason. The perk is a shared session, not a bigger discount.
data.conditions: ≈18% effective for a newcomer, ≈16% for a member renewing.

data.name: Group Project (Finally, Everyone Pulls Their Weight)
data.headline: Group projects: usually one person does all the work. Not here.
data.benefit: Group projects: usually one person does all the work. Not here. Buy as a squad of 4 and everyone gets 25% off. Free-loaders still have to do the planks.
data.rationale: Bulk purchase is one of the few places 25% is allowed. Groups attend together (higher usage → higher renewal) and bring four new names per sale.
data.conditions: Bulk rule: 4+ packs in one transaction. Off-peak only. Claim by 2027-06-30.
data.kpi: Squads sold; squad members buying again within 60 days.

data.rationale: 2026 anniversary-code buyers renewed at only 24.5%. Attendance in the month after purchase is the best predictor of renewal; the reward is earned by it.

steps.label: W1
steps.text: Set up Mom Said Get Off the Couch in Momence (2027-05-01 to 2027-06-30): Students and under-25s (ID checked): 8-class pack at 20% off — Mumbai ₹10,500, Kenkere ₹6,972, pop-ups ₹5,544 — valid 45 days, Golden Hours only (Mon–Fri 10 am–12 pm, Sat–Sun 4–7 pm). On sale 1 May–30 Jun.

steps.label: W3
steps.text: Mid-month review against ₹18.7L: by the 15th aim for ~half of 60 new buyers (278 first visits), 44 renewals and 31 winbacks. Push the lists, not a deeper discount.
